subject: Demo timing, timezone lock and evidence request
messages:
From: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.com>
To: Samir Khan <samir.k@nimbus-analytics.com>, Laura Chen <laura.chen@nimbus-analytics.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-09-12T13:02:00-07:00
Subject: Post-call: Next steps + demo windows

Hi Samir / Laura —

Thanks again for a great discovery call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we keep momentum: 

- Goal: 60m technical deep dive / demo focused on inference economics (latency, cost, and VPC deployment options) for your ML platform and procurement team.
- Outcomes we want: hands-on demo, example perf numbers for your 8k token workload, checklist of security artifacts we can provide.

Can we lock a demo slot next week? To make scheduling easy across time zones, here are three options (all times PT / ET):
1) Tue 9/19 10:00am PT / 1:00pm ET — 60m
2) Wed 9/20 11:00am PT / 2:00pm ET — 60m (preferred on our side)
3) Thu 9/21 8:30am PT / 11:30am ET — 60m

Please reply with which slot works and the best contact from your security and procurement teams so we can loop them in. If you prefer a different day/time, propose two alternatives and we’ll adapt.

I’ve attached a short discovery recap and an evidence checklist (already tailored to the items you asked about).

Attachments: discovery-recap.pdf; evidence-checklist.xlsx

Thanks — looking forward to locking this in.

Best,
Chloe Martin
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
chloe.martin@redwood.com
From: Samir Khan <samir.k@nimbus-analytics.com>
To: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Chen <laura.chen@nimbus-analytics.com>
Date: 2028-09-12T14:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call: Next steps + demo windows

Chloe — thanks for the clear recap. Wed 9/20 at 2:00pm ET (option 2) works well for our team.

Looping in procurement (procurement@nimbus-analytics.com) and our security operations alias (security_ops@nimbus-analytics.com) so they see the ask and can confirm whether they need any preread.

Note: Our procurement manager Laura (cc’d) would like a 30-minute pre-demo touchpoint to go over contracting cadence and PO requirements — would that be possible the same day at 1:15pm ET? No problem if your team prefers a different time.

Also, we prefer all invites in ET if possible — helps avoid confusion for our global team.

Appreciate you sending the checklist; I’ll share internally.

—Samir
Head of ML Platforms | Nimbus Analytics
samir.k@nimbus-analytics.com
From: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.com>
To: Samir Khan <samir.k@nimbus-analytics.com>, Laura Chen <laura.chen@nimbus-analytics.com>, procurement@nimbus-analytics.com, security_ops@nimbus-analytics.com
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-09-12T15:00:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call: Next steps + demo windows

Thanks Samir — great. Looping in internal owners so we can coordinate:
- Rishi Malhotra (procurement & commercial cadence) — rishi.malhotra@redwood.com
- Monica Patel (security & compliance) — monica.patel@redwood.com

We’ll plan to lock Wed 9/20 2:00pm ET for the technical deep dive (60m) and schedule a 30m procurement pre-call at 1:15pm ET the same day. I’ll send calendar invites in ET and include a short agenda for both meetings.

Attached again: discovery-recap.pdf (summary of initial call), evidence-checklist.xlsx (SOC2 / access logs / KMS details we typically surface). Monica — please flag any additional artifacts we should prep for Samir’s team.

Next steps (today):
- I’ll send two calendar invites (1:15pm ET procurement touch / 2:00pm ET demo).
- Rishi will follow up on contracting cadence & DocuSign link.
- Monica will confirm security artifacts and whether a brief 15m pre-demo with your security engineer is needed.

Thanks — sending invites now.

Chloe
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: procurement@nimbus-analytics.com, Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.com>, Samir Khan <samir.k@nimbus-analytics.com>, Laura Chen <laura.chen@nimbus-analytics.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-09-13T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call: Next steps + demo windows

Thanks Chloe / Samir — I can take the procurement pre-call on 9/20 at 1:15pm ET. Quick note on process so Nimbus knows what to expect: 

- Standard path: we’ll issue a SaaS addendum + SOW and send DocuSign for signature.
- If Nimbus requires custom legal redlines, please share them early (we prefer to review before Demo but can accept after if timing is tight).
- PO: we accept standard PO numbers; if you require net-45/60 terms, flag that now so we can route appropriately.

DocuSign (sample envelope for reference): https://docusign.net/envelope/ABCDE12345

I’ll prepare a short commercial checklist on the pre-call (pricing bands, invoicing cadence, any discount approvals needed). Marissa — I’ll sync with you on the SOW template.

Rishi Malhotra
Director, Commercial Operations | Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwood.com
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Samir Khan <samir.k@nimbus-analytics.com>, Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Laura Chen <laura.chen@nimbus-analytics.com>
Date: 2028-09-14T09:31:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call: Next steps + demo windows

Hi all —

I’ll own the security artifacts and can confirm the following are available for the demo/pre-read: 
- SOC 2 report (Redwood Inference) — redwood_socs_report_2027.pdf (share link below)
- High-level network diagram + VPC architecture notes
- KMS/HSM integration brief and data retention policy summary

If Nimbus’s security engineer wants to do a short 15m call before the demo, I’m available Tue 9/19 4:00pm ET or Wed 9/20 12:30pm ET — the latter would be tight but possible if helpful.

Drive link with artifacts: https://drive.redwood.com/file/d/1A2B3C

I’ll add the artifacts to the demo invite and include a short slide (1 slide) showing expected perf for an 8k token workload so we can discuss tradeoffs.

Thanks — see the calendar invite (2:00pm ET demo) — invites include ET times as requested.

Monica Patel
Security and Compliance Manager | Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.com
